California.reason: California Business and Professions Code Section 16600 voids post-employment non-competes regardless of the contract's stated governing law.

Washington.reason: Washington State law restricts non-competes for employees earning less than the mandated threshold, and strictly limits duration.

India.reason: Section 27 of the Indian Contract Act voids post-employment non-competes, overriding foreign governing law clauses if executed locally.

Maharashtra.reason: MahaRERA Rules, 2017 cap advance payments at 10% and mandate RERA registration. Section 27 of Indian Contract Act voids post-employment non-competes.

Karnataka.reason: Karnataka Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Rules, 1961 mandate specific termination procedures and notice periods.

Delhi.reason: Delhi High Court consistently holds post-employment non-competes void under Section 27, Indian Contract Act.

Tamil Nadu.reason: Tamil Nadu Shops and Establishments Act imposes specific wage and termination protections.

Gujarat.reason: Gujarat RERA rules and Section 27 protections apply.
